UPDATE child_info
chinesewordcount = #{chineseWordCount},
englishwordcount = #{englishWordCount},
poetrycount = #{poetryCount},
age = #{age},
birthdate = #{birthDate},
record_date = #{recordDate},
head_circ = #{headCirc},
weight = #{weight},
height = #{height},
where child_id = #{childId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.family_id, c.child_id, c.child_name, c.sex, c.age, c.idnumber, f.family_name AS familyName FROM child_info c LEFT JOIN family_info f ON c.family_id = f.family_id WHERE c.family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT e.*, ei.expert_name AS doctorName FROM personal_examination_record e LEFT JOIN expert_info ei ON e.doctor_id = ei.expert_id WHERE NOW() < e.start_time AND NOW() < e.end_time

SELECT a.appoint_id AS appointId, e.examination_id AS examinationId, c.child_name AS childName, ei.expert_name AS doctorName, e.start_time AS startTime, e.end_time AS endDate, CASE WHEN NOW() < e.start_time THEN 1 WHEN NOW() >= e.start_time AND NOW() <= e.end_time THEN 2 WHEN NOW() > e.end_time AND NOW() <= DATE_ADD(e.end_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 3 ELSE NULL END AS status FROM examination_appoint a JOIN child_info c ON a.child_id = c.child_id JOIN personal_examination_record e ON a.examination_id = e.examination_id LEFT JOIN expert_info ei ON e.doctor_id = ei.expert_id WHERE c.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC
